leech.name: Leech
leech.short: A specialist in technology and sabotage
leech.text: Makes drugs, essences and bombs, treats wounds, builds tools, and knows how to break things.
leech.xpTrigger: Gain xp when you address a challenge with your expertise or by causing a commotion.
list: What are they about to do?
How can I get them to [X]?
What could I tinker with here?

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.text: +1 effect for alchemical creations; start with one free recipe.

analyst.name: Analyst
analyst.text: In downtime, two extra advances between projects for investigations or new recipes and plans.

counter.name: Extra project segments
counter.hint: +2 segments for investigations, recipes and plans

physicker.name: Physicker
physicker.text: Tinker to treat wounds and work with the body; the whole crew gets +1d to healing rolls; first aid.

tinker.name: Artificer
tinker.text: +1 effect for spark-craft creations; start with one free plan.

ghost-ward.name: Ghost Ward
ghost-ward.text: Make an area anathema or enticing to ghosts for several days.

saboteur.name: Saboteur
saboteur.text: Wreck quietly; the damage is unnoticeable at a casual glance.

fortitude.name: Fortitude
fortitude.text: Special armor: resist consequences of fatigue, weakness or chemicals, or push yourself with tech and chemistry for free.

venomous.name: Venomous
venomous.text: Immune to one poison or drug from your bandolier; can exude it through skin, saliva or vapor (by pushing yourself).

fine-tinkering-tools.name: Fine Tinkering Tools
fine-tinkering-tools.text: A kit for working with mechanisms; loupe, measuring devices.

fine-wrecking-tools.name: Fine Wrecking Tools
fine-wrecking-tools.text: A demolition kit: drill, hammer and wedges, crowbar, acid, spark-cutter.

blowgun-and-darts.name: Blowgun & Darts, Syringes
blowgun-and-darts.text: A tube and darts for alchemical substances; empty syringes.

alchemists-bandolier.name: Alchemist's Bandolier
alchemists-bandolier.text: Three pockets for alchemical substances or bombs; refills in downtime with access to a supplier or workshop.

gadgets.name: Gadgets
gadgets.text: Made in downtime with Tinker; load 1+ for each gadget.

stazia.name: Stazia
stazia.text: A former criminal gone into legitimate alchemy, or the other way round.

veldren.name: Veldren
veldren.text: An addict or an explorer of psychedelic worlds.

eckerd.name: Eckerd
eckerd.text: Perhaps a source of raw materials.

jul.name: Jul
jul.text: What other unusual clients make use of his services?

malista.name: Malista
malista.text: Which forgotten god does she serve?
